Definition
[Continuous subharmonic functions] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-ii:page-0178 1. ch12:12.15\group Weak Scalar Maximum Principles

A continuous function $u$ on an open set $\Omega $ is subharmonic if, for every relatively compact domain $D\Subset \Omega $ and every harmonic $h$ on $D$ with $u\leq h$ on $\partial D$, one has $u\leq h$ on $D$. It is superharmonic if $-u$ is subharmonic and harmonic if it is both.
